name: Interlace Wipe
description: The second clip loads over the first like an interlaced picture on a slow connection: a first pass sweeps down drawing it in big blocky rows, then each new pass sweeps down again at twice the detail until the picture is sharp. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: rows
params.description: Number of rows of pixels of the picture being loaded, before its last pass draws it at full detail

params.name: passes
params.description: Number of passes, the first one drawing blocks 2^(passes - 1) rows tall

params.name: glow
params.description: Brightness of the freshly drawn rows behind each sweep
